verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy is a SaaS payments platform that handles merchant and customer data, so whether that data can be kept out of AI training is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack has nothing on AI training, an opt-out control, or a data-usage policy. It covers only payments, the API, webhooks, pricing and community fee complaints, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
